runner: headless Chrome over CDP; real mouse / keyboard input

steps.name: intro
steps.action: Open the app in an empty browser profile
steps.expected: The V2 introduction (kept): title, plant field from real instances, one Start

steps.name: landscapes
steps.action: Click Start
steps.expected: Three landscape cards; Detroit enterable, two Planned; no saved design to continue

steps.name: define-entry
steps.action: Click the Detroit card
steps.expected: Define in Plan over the whole garden: scope on the map, the panel starts with the scope; no timeline, no month, no performance legend, no brush

steps.name: define-click-B2
steps.action: Click bed B2 on the map
steps.expected: Only B2 is the candidate (dashed outline, others quietened); a strategy is proposed for it; Continue waits for the confirmation

steps.name: define-confirm-B2
steps.action: Click Confirm
steps.expected: Scope = B2 (one undo step)

steps.name: structure-fit-B2
steps.action: Continue to Structure (no wheel, no manual zoom); confirm the cells
steps.expected: The camera fits B2: it fills the free canvas (≥ 55 % of the width or height, fully inside), numbered cells readable; scope IDs = [B2]

steps.name: compose-fit-B2
steps.action: Continue to Compose
steps.expected: Compose keeps the bed's working scale (fit of the scope = B2); the mix palette is the panel

steps.name: compose-paint-B2
steps.action: Click the first mix card, hover over B2, then drag a short stroke
steps.expected: A hover preview with a cursor chip (bed · cell · light · fit · +n); the stroke plants in one undo step

steps.name: define-return
steps.action: Click step 1 (Define)
steps.expected: Define shows its own view (Plan, no timeline / month / legend / brush); the B2 plants are kept

steps.name: define-multi
steps.action: Shift-click B1; Shift-drag a box over A2 and C2; Confirm
steps.expected: B1, B2, A2, C2 (two walks between them) are the new scope; B2 keeps its plants

steps.name: structure-multi-fit
steps.action: Continue to Structure; confirm the new beds (one click)
steps.expected: Only the new beds are previewed (B2 kept), one confirmation; the camera fits the union of all scope beds

steps.name: structure-focus-overview
steps.action: Click B1 on the map (local focus), then Overview in the breadcrumb
steps.expected: B1 fills the canvas, breadcrumb Detroit / scope / B1; the scope and the other beds stay; Overview returns to the whole scope

steps.name: conditions-assumptions
steps.action: Compose → Conditions (dock); focus B1 (breadcrumb) → Sun; B2 → Shade; C2 → Part; A2 untouched; Overview
steps.expected: Explicit project assumptions per bed (labelled), the crown proxy kept, A2 unknown

actual.legend: Conditionssun · assumedpart shade · assumedshade · assumedunder a crown · proxyunknownFocus a bed to set a light assumpt

steps.name: fit-two-mixes
steps.action: Click the Colour-blocks mix, then the Organic-groups mix (Conditions on → Mix fit)
steps.expected: Fit per cell from the real members' light records: B1 (sun) fits, B2 (shade) conflicts, C2 (part) differs between the mixes (sun-only vs sun · part members), A2 unknown

actual.note: C2 (part shade): same category, different shares and named conflicting members; the stripes' density shows the share

steps.name: layer-off-still-computes
steps.action: Turn Conditions off, hover the Colour-blocks brush over B2 (shade assumed)
steps.expected: The map layer is off but the rule still applies: sun-recorded members are skipped in the preview (count shown in the chip)

actual.chip: B2·6 · shade (assumed) · conflict (32 % of the recipe known)+10 · 64 replaced · 31 skipped

steps.name: hover-states
steps.action: Hover the Colour-blocks brush over B1 (sun), B2 (shade), A2 (unknown), the walk, and a frozen cell (frozen through the cell inspector)
steps.expected: Each place says what would happen next to the cursor: plants to add, skipped for light, unknown, blocked (path), blocked (frozen) — never only 'no plantable cell'

legal-B1.chip: B1·9 · sun (assumed) · fits (32 % of the recipe known)+41

conflict-B2.chip: B2·6 · shade (assumed) · conflict (32 % of the recipe known)+12 · 61 replaced · 30 skipped

steps.name: live-stroke-two-beds
steps.action: Dropseed-matrix brush: press in B1, 30 real moves across the walk into B2 (button held), release; Undo; Redo
steps.expected: Plants appear in ≥ 3 frames while held (nothing committed until release), the walk gets none, both beds change in ONE undo step; undo / redo exact

steps.name: metric-brush-two-zooms
steps.action: Stroke 3 m across unplanted ground of A2 at the fit zoom, then of C2 after two wheel zooms
steps.expected: Both strokes add plants (fresh ground each time); at both scales the plants lie within the same metric radius of the stroke

steps.name: overlap-layers
steps.action: Colour-blocks base over the B1 matrix; then the same stroke with Overlay only; then a Soft-edge matrix stroke back over it
steps.expected: Preview shows replacements before the click; base replaced only inside the footprint, other layers kept; overlay-only adds overlays and leaves the base; soft edge leaves a mixed rim

steps.name: cell-fill-auto
steps.action: Click an empty cell → Fill (inspector); Auto compose → Accept
steps.expected: Cell Fill and Auto Compose use the same engine (one undo step each); the frozen cell is skipped

steps.name: explore-result-space
steps.action: Continue to Explore; switch Plan → 3D → Diagram → Performance → Plan in the dock
steps.expected: Own layout: big canvas with only the design scope (context off), panel closed, top bar (Design · options · export), dock with views + months; every view shows the same instances (fingerprint) and result revision

steps.name: months-play
steps.action: Click April, then August on the month line; 3D in August; Play for ~2.5 s, then Pause
steps.expected: Known flowering changes with the month in Plan and in 3D (not-flowering plants lose their flower colour, unknown turn grey); coordinates and recipes unchanged; Play advances, Pause stops

steps.name: community-inspector
steps.action: Save option; click the planted ground of B1 in Explore; Edit in Compose; repaint a little; back to Explore
steps.expected: The inspector lists the real plants of the fragments at the click (counts = instances), layers planned vs placed, why lines (system · roles · space · overlap · brief · light); Compose opens with those cells; the new result has a higher revision; the saved option is unchanged

steps.name: metrics-illustrative
steps.action: Read the result metrics; switch the illustrative layer off (Define → Brief and sources) and look again; switch it back on
steps.expected: Planted footprint < structured area (stated denominators, perf/3); with the teaching layer off unknown rises and known flowering falls — unknown is never 0

steps.expected: Only this project's Detroit plants by default (no Vancouver plants); each reading fits its question; region of the spatial records stated; the record's effect previewed (metrics and mix fit) and applied; unknown falls; back in the design
